Create a POST endpoint for advanced query builder (JSON-based query DSL). Support nested conditions, joins. Return 200.

task_id: advanced-query-builder-endpoint
summary: "Implement a POST endpoint for an advanced JSON-based query DSL that supports nested conditions and joins"
depends_on: ["stage-1-core-models", "stage-2-api-routes"]
local_goals:
  - id: L1
    description: "INSPECT: check existing API routes structure to ensure no conflicting endpoints"
    verification:
      type: cli
      command: "cat apps/api/src/routes/queries.ts"
      expect:
        exit_code: 0
  - id: L2
    description: "CREATE: add POST /v1/queries endpoint for advanced query builder"
    verification:
      type: cli
      command: "pnpm build --filter=@verified-attention/api"
      expect:
        exit_code: 0
  - id: L3
    description: "VERIFY: POST /v1/queries returns 200 with a valid JSON-based query DSL response"
    verification:
      type: http
      method: POST
      url: http://localhost:3000/v1/queries
      headers:
        Authorization: "Bearer {test_token}"
      body:
        contentId: "test-content"
        query: '{"filter": {"and": [{"eq": {"field": "status", "value": "active"}}, {"gt": {"field": "createdAt", "value": "2023-01-01"}}]}}'
      expect:
        status: 200
        json_schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            queryId: { type: string }
            results: { type: array }
          required: [queryId, results]
global_goals_refs: ["G5", "G13"]

Add a GET endpoint for migration progress dashboard (records migrated, errors, lag). Per table. Return 200.

task_id: migration-progress-dashboard
summary: "Add a GET endpoint to display migration progress dashboard"
depends_on: ["stage-1-core-models", "stage-2-pipeline"]
local_goals:
  - id: L1
    description: "INSPECT: check existing migration model and routes before adding endpoints"
    verification:
      type: file_exists
      path: "src/models/Migration.ts"
      expect:
        exists: true
  - id: L2
    description: "INSPECT: check existing API routes structure"
    verification:
      type: cli
      command: "cat apps/api/src/routes/migrations.ts"
      expect:
        exit_code: 0
  - id: L3
    description: "CREATE: add GET /v1/migrations/progress endpoint and migration model extensions"
    verification:
      type: cli
      command: "pnpm build --filter=@verified-attention/api"
      expect:
        exit_code: 0
  - id: L4
    description: "VERIFY: GET /v1/migrations/progress returns migration progress dashboard"
    verification:
      type: http
      method: GET
      url: http://localhost:3000/v1/migrations/progress
      headers:
        Authorization: "Bearer {test_token}"
      expect:
        status: 200
        json_schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            table: { type: string }
            recordsMigrated: { type: integer }
            errors: { type: array }
            lag: { type: number }
          required: [table, recordsMigrated, errors, lag]

Implement structured logging with correlation IDs, user IDs, session IDs. JSON format. PII scrubbing. Log levels configurable.

task_id: structured-logging
summary: "Implement structured logging with correlation IDs, user IDs, session IDs in JSON format, PII scrubbing, and configurable log levels"
depends_on: ["stage-1-core-models", "stage-2-auth-middleware"]
local_goals:
  - id: L1
    description: "INSPECT: check existing logging configuration before adding structured logging"
    verification:
      type: file_exists
      path: "src/config/logging.ts"
      expect:
        exists: true
  - id: L2
    description: "CREATE/MODIFY: add structured logging middleware to capture correlation IDs, user IDs, and session IDs"
    verification:
      type: cli
      command: "pnpm build --filter=@verified-attention/api"
      expect:
        exit_code: 0
  - id: L3
    description: "CREATE/MODIFY: configure log levels in the logging configuration file"
    verification:
      type: file_exists
      path: "src/config/logging.ts"
      expect:
        content_contains: "logLevels: {"
  - id: L4
    description: "VERIFY: structured logs contain correlation IDs, user IDs, and session IDs"
    verification:
      type: cli
      command: "pnpm test --filter=@verified-attention/api -- --testPathPattern=structured-logging"
      expect:
        exit_code: 0
  - id: L5
    description: "VERIFY: PII is scrubbed from logs"
    verification:
      type: cli
      command: "pnpm test --filter=@verified-attention/api -- --testPathPattern=pii-scrubbing"
      expect:
        exit_code: 0

Create a POST endpoint for user to submit a support ticket. Categorize, assign priority. Return 201 with ticket ID. Integrate with ticketing system.

task_id: create-support-ticket-endpoint
summary: "Implement a POST endpoint for users to submit support tickets, categorize, assign priority, and return the ticket ID"
depends_on: ["stage-1-authentication", "stage-2-user-profiles"]
local_goals:
  - id: L1
    description: "INSPECT: check existing user model and routes before adding endpoints"
    verification:
      type: file_exists
      path: "src/models/User.ts"
      expect:
        exists: true
  - id: L2
    description: "CREATE: add POST /api/support/tickets endpoint and ticket model extensions"
    verification:
      type: cli
      command: "pnpm build --filter=@verified-attention/api"
      expect:
        exit_code: 0
  - id: L3
    description: "VERIFY: POST /api/support/tickets creates a support ticket and returns ticket ID"
    verification:
      type: http
      method: POST
      url: http://localhost:3000/api/support/tickets
      headers:
        Authorization: "Bearer {test_token}"
      body:
        content: "I'm facing an issue with my account."
        category: "Account Management"
        priority: "High"
      expect:
        status: 201
        json_schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            ticketId: { type: string }
          required: [ticketId]
